description: CR 509.3a a Guard that does not block is not pumped
note: The control leg for bushido's blocking half, on the same board: bob's Inner-Chamber Guard does not block alice's Goblin Piker, so CR 509.3a's event never happens and the Guard stays 0/2 while the Piker's 2 reaches bob. An ability that pumped on any combat event would pass the blocking case and fail this one.
